title: Celebrating America's Birthday with a Sasquatch Sighting
title_norm: celebrating americas birthday with a sasquatch sighting
snippet: It was America's 250th birthday this past July 4th - how did you celebrate? I visited friends and ate pizza they made in their outdoor pizza oven. So delicious! I know lots of people who went to barbecues, to the beach, and, of course, to watch fireworks. There are many fun ways to celebrate…
